topic.label: Banking, Payments and Insurance

concepts.label: Banking and Lending
concepts.desc: Deposits, loans, credit cards, underwriting, interest and bank capital.

concepts.label: Investment Banks and Their Divisions
concepts.desc: How investment banks are organized: banking, sales and trading, research, prime services and asset management.

concepts.label: Insurance
concepts.desc: Life, property, casualty and health insurance, premiums, underwriting and claims.

concepts.label: Payments
concepts.desc: Card networks, ACH, wires, real-time payments, processors and fees.

concepts.label: Wealth Management and Brokerage
concepts.desc: Advisors, brokerage accounts, fiduciary duty, account types and fees.

concepts.label: Cross-Border Payments
concepts.desc: Sending money across borders: SWIFT, correspondent banking, remittances, fees and timing.

skills.label: Loan Comparator
skills.desc: Compares loans by APR, fees and terms, and computes total cost.

skills.label: Investment Bank Map
skills.desc: Maps an investment bank's divisions, what each does and how they interact on a deal.

skills.label: Coverage Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews an insurance policy's coverage, exclusions and deductibles.

skills.label: Payment Flow Explainer
skills.desc: Explains how a payment moves between payer, processor, network and payee, with fees and timing.

skills.label: Account Type Guide
skills.desc: Explains brokerage and retirement account types and their tax treatment.

skills.label: Cross-Border Payment Planner
skills.desc: Plans a cross-border payment route with fees, timing and compliance checks.
